'''Salix''' was a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who [[Bartender/Legends|bartended]] [[Slag Pit/Legends|The Slag Pit]], a gambling den located on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. He ran the Pit's day-to-day operations while its owner, [[Odrell Vorbaal]], sold [[Spice/Legends|spice]].<ref name="LoNH" />
